# CardBody

Card slot: main content region of a `Card`. Static presentational `<div>` carrying the card's internal padding.

Import: `import { CardBody } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |

## Accessibility

- Static component rendered as plain semantic HTML; roles/ARIA are set by the component where needed (see description).
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardBody>Usage this month: 4,210 requests.</CardBody>
</Card>
```
